messages:
Aj (AE): Quick sync — Zenith asked for a commitment: sustained 1.2k rps with 50k token avg payloads, plus 3x burst for promos. They want reserved GPUs + burst credits. How do we size and protect latency SLOs?
Maria (Solutions): 1.2k sustained at 50k tokens is heavy. We should propose a two‑tier plan: reserved capacity sized for sustained qps and a bounded burst escrow for short spikes. Also recommend quantized model variant for cost.
Ben (SRE): Agreed. Need to know expected sequence length distribution. If 90% are 2–4k tokens and 10% are the 50k outliers that changes GPU memory and KV cache strategy.
Sonia (Sales Eng): Zenith said 50k is for documents that are rare (~2% of calls). Most chat is short. They want <150ms p95 for short calls and <5s for long ones.
Maria (Solutions): For short calls we can pack into smaller batch windows. For the long docs we should route to a long‑context pool (different instance flavor) to avoid hurting latency.
Ben (SRE): Proposal draft for autoscale + burst escrow (feel free to copy into the SOW):
```
autoscale_policy:
  min_gpus: 4
  reserved_gpus: 8     # covers sustained 1.2k rps w/ headroom
  burst_escrow_credits: 2400  # credits translate to X gpu‑seconds
  max_burst_gpus: 16
  burst_window_s: 900   # 15m smoothing window
  cooldown_s: 300
  kv_preheat_minutes: 20
  fallback_model: quant-approx-1b
```
Ben (SRE): The escrow credits are consumed when burst usage exceeds reserved capacity; they cap cost and allow graceful reject once exhausted.
Aj (AE): Can we map credits to dollars to show them expected worst-case spend for a 1h Black Friday spike?
Maria (Solutions): Rough calc: 8 reserved gpus = baseline; adding 8 burst gpus for 1h ~ cost_gpus_per_hour * 8. I'll run numbers and give a table.
Sonia (Sales Eng): Also need to confirm AZ affinity and preheat window — they insist on <10% chance of cold KV misses during promo.
Ben (SRE): KV warmup: we can prefetch top prefixes and keep a hot cache on reserved pool. The autoscale policy above has kv_preheat_minutes: 20 which should reduce misses. For extreme coldstarts we recommend a preheat job that runs 5–10 min before promo starts.
Aj (AE): Can we add canary fallback behavior so if a new model rollout coincides with promo we don't regress?
Maria (Solutions): Yes — add a canary route with traffic=5% and automatic rollback threshold on p95 latency and error rate.
Ben (SRE): Suggested canary snippet:
```
rollout:
  canary_percent: 5
  rollback_on:
    p95_latency_increase_pct: 30
    error_rate_increase_pct: 0.5
```
Sonia (Sales Eng): Legal/security Q: does burst escrow require any extra contractual language for dedicated vs hosted?
Maria (Solutions): For Dedicated we can include burst terms in the commitment. For hosted we have standard T&Cs but can add a one‑time addendum for reserved+burst billing. I'll loop legal.
Aj (AE): Zenith also sent a security questionnaire asking about KMS for model keys and audit logs during bursts. Ben, does autoscale/bursting preserve audit trails?
Ben (SRE): Yes — every instance in the burst pool logs to the same centralized audit sink and uses customer KMS for ephemeral keys. No data is stored outside their VPC if we use their Private deployment — we should call that out.
Aj (AE): Action items:
- Maria: cost table for baseline vs 1h/3h promo spikes (by EOD)
- Ben: validate kv_preheat_minutes=20 is sufficient and run a quick sim of 3x bursts (tomorrow)
- Sonia: draft the contractual bullet on burst escrow and hand off to legal
- Aj: confirm promo schedule with Zenith and share preheat window
Maria (Solutions): Will do. FYI, recommend also offering a low‑cost quantized fallback model to reduce burst spend if they accept slightly lower quality.
Sonia (Sales Eng): I'll include that as an option in the SOW (named "eco burst").
InfraBot: New runbook created: /runs/3928-reserved-burst-escrow-oncall — contains escalation points and preheat checklist.
Aj (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll sync with Zenith and share our proposal + cost table. :thumbsup:
Ben (SRE): SGTM. If Zenith wants deep dive, we can schedule a 30m architecture call and run a live profiling session.
Maria (Solutions): I'll prepare the profiling template and sample logs.
Sonia (Sales Eng): Marking this as paused until promo date confirmed.
Aj (AE): Closing loop — promo confirmed for 2026-11-26 00:00 UTC. We'll run a preheat at 23:30 UTC.
Ben (SRE): Noted — will run the 3x burst sim at 22:00 UTC today and post results here.
Maria (Solutions): Posted cost table: https://redwood.docs/sales/zenith-costs (internal)
Sonia (Sales Eng): Thanks — sending SOW draft now.
